what: 1. /design Voter 1 prompt is outside the proposed shared OOS instruction path
scenario_or_breakage: The plan updates dispatch-plan-voters.sh for external Voter 2/3 only, but /design also launches a Claude Code Reviewer Voter 1 from plan-review.md with a separate hand-written prompt and no canonical OOS problem-vs-solution clause; one judge in the /design panel can still vote OOS_N based on a disliked remedy, violating the acceptance criterion that /design plan voting emits the same OOS judging instruction.
suggested_fix: Route Voter 1 through the shared renderer or update the plan-review.md Voter 1 instruction to include the byte-identical canonical clause, then add harness coverage that the Voter 1 prompt/prose contains it.

what: 2. Standalone /review main-agent fallback is not covered
scenario_or_breakage: The feature requires main-agent fallback to receive the same OOS clause, but the plan only updates skills/design/SKILL.md and skills/implement/SKILL.md; standalone /review can receive REVIEW_CORE_STATUS=main-agent-vote-required from review-core.sh, while review/SKILL.md has no canonical OOS adjudication prose for that path.
suggested_fix: Add the canonical clause to the actual standalone /review main-agent adjudication contract, likely review/SKILL.md and/or review-core.md around the main-agent-vote-required status, without changing scoring or tier behavior beyond importing the clause.

what: 3. Drift guard omits two required canonical copies
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says the canonical clause lives in four places, but the proposed drift guard only greps rendered output and skills/shared/voting-protocol.md; stale skills/design/SKILL.md or skills/implement/SKILL.md MAV text would still pass CI even though main-agent fallback would no longer emit the same OOS instruction.
suggested_fix: Extend case_canonical_text_drift_guard to grep the exact canonical string in skills/design/SKILL.md and skills/implement/SKILL.md as well, and include any added /review or Voter 1 prose if those surfaces receive literal copies.

what: 4. New helper executable mode is unspecified while callers execute it directly
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed wrappers invoke skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh as a command; if the new file lands with normal non-executable patch mode, voter dispatch fails with permission denied before launching judges.
suggested_fix: Specify that render-voter-prompt.sh and its harness get executable git mode, or invoke the renderer with bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh" from both dispatchers.
